description: This file implements the SetVideoGeometry class, which is responsible for setting the video geometry in a media player context. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute methods that update the pending geometry and invoke a method on the player object.

classes.name: SetVideoGeometry
classes.description: A class that manages setting the video geometry for a media player within a specific context.

methods.name: SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the given context, player, and rectangle.

methods.name: ~SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the action of setting the pending geometry and updating the player if the pipeline exists.
